triggers.note: At each town's opening feast, its Keeper's notice on its board, once.

effect.words: May I sit with you a while?
effect.reply: Sit, my child. Still. The howl remembers who sat still. Restday is the sitting day: three of them, and then you howl it for me at the pool. My voice is old; yours will carry.
At dusk, here at the creek, I'll sing you the first turn. It goes round twice, no? Twice round the reeds and back.

effect.words: May I sit with you a while?
effect.reply: If you like. The infirmarian sent me out for the air. He thinks I don't notice when he worries. I do.
Hold still. No reason. An infirmarian likes to look. Mm. I'll write that down, if you'll let me.
Then the silver's the Crown's and the seam's mine. Fair catch, eh?
Then I'll sell where it lies to someone who'll pay, eh? Don't look at me like that.

effect.words: I'll carry the House's pledge to a debtor.
effect.reply: Good. A debtor in the city signs their howl to the House, and the House forgets a month of interest. Bring me the signature. The Counting House pays its own.

A howl goes round the reeds of Withy Creek twice before it comes back. Mirebridge's old howl has been found.

quests.title: Ridgemere's Gathering Howl
quests.summary: Find Ridgemere's old gathering howl: three old wolves hold a piece each.

offer.ask: What is the old gathering howl?
offer.say: #greet#. The city's gathering howl is older than the walls. Three of our oldest hold a piece each. Ask them twice; they'll give you half the first time.
offer.handIn: I have the howl, and I sang it with you.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Now Ridgemere has its own howl again. Walk it far.
offer.during: Still looking? The old ones sit at the Grey Gull and the Knucklebones of an evening. Ask twice.

objectives.label: Ask the old wolf of the Knucklebones evenings for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the old wolf by the Grey Gull fire for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the other old wolf of the Grey Gull for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
At dusk, ask the Keeper (at the Grey Gull of an evening) to "Howl it with me", and howl with them at once.

quests.title: Coldwater's Gathering Howl
quests.summary: Find Coldwater's old gathering howl: three old wolves hold a piece each.

offer.ask: Which is the gathering howl, then?
offer.say: #greet#. We've a howl for the drowned, one for a catch and one for supper, and I'd not swear which, eh? The old ones know the gathering one. Ask three.
offer.handIn: I have it, and we sang it together.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. That's it, deep and true. Calm water.
offer.during: The old hands at the Still know it. Catch them at work, and ask twice, eh?

objectives.label: Ask the oldest still hand at the Coldwater Still for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the old still hand who minds the apples for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the stillmaster for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
At dusk, ask the Keeper (in the Coldwater loom shed) to "Howl it with me", and howl with them at once.

quests.title: Larkfield's Gathering Howl
quests.summary: Find Larkfield's old gathering howl: three old wolves hold a piece each.

offer.ask: What does Larkfield howl for a gathering?
offer.say: #greet#. Larkfield's howl goes up at the end like a price. Three old ones have it in pieces. Short-weighed, the lot of them, unless you ask twice.
offer.accept: I'll weigh it out of them.
offer.handIn: Full weight, and sung with you.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Full weight! Larkfield howls the old one again.
offer.during: The bakehouse and the linen shed have the old ones. Ask twice, and count what you get.

objectives.label: Ask the old shop hand at the Larkfield Bakehouse for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the Larkfield baker for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the old loom hand at the Larkfield linen shed for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
At dusk, ask the Keeper (in the Larkfield linen shed) to "Howl it with me", and howl with them at once.

quests.title: Southmeadow's Gathering Howl
quests.summary: Find Southmeadow's old gathering howl: three old wolves hold a piece each.

offer.ask: Is there an older howl than the harvest one?
offer.say: #greet#. Our gathering howl? I've only ever known the harvest one. The old ones will know. Ask three, and ask twice.
offer.handIn: I found it, and we sang it in the Apple Tree.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Ripe and right. A good harvest of a howl.
offer.during: Larkholm has two of them at the granary and the mill, and one digs clay at the Sallow pits.

objectives.label: Ask the old farmhand at the Larkholm granary for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the miller at Larkholm for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the clay digger at the Sallow pits for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
At dusk, ask the Keeper (in the Apple Tree, Southmeadow's inn) to "Howl it with me", and howl with them at once.

quests.title: Fenshore's Gathering Howl
quests.summary: Find Fenshore's old gathering howl: three old wolves hold a piece each.

offer.ask: What happened to the Fenshore howl?
offer.say: #greet#. Fenshore's howl went thin when Mirebridge went under. Three old ones still have bits. Ask them twice, no?
offer.handIn: I have the bits, and we sang them together.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Fen-sure, that's it. Dry feet to you.
offer.during: The old one sits by the eel house at Withy Creek now. The others cut peat and pour at the Heron.

objectives.label: Ask the old Eelbank by the Withy Creek eel house for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the old peat cutter at the Fenshore cutting for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the pot hand at the Heron for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
At dusk, ask the Keeper (at Fenshore Stores) to "Howl it with me", and howl with them at once.

quests.title: Saltwell's Gathering Howl
quests.summary: Find Saltwell's old gathering howl: three old wolves hold a piece each.

offer.ask: Who keeps the old howl here?
offer.say: #greet#. The well's howl is old, and the old one at the pool keeps it. Two more know pieces. Sit with them; do not hurry them, and ask twice.
offer.handIn: I have it, and we sang it together.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. The well remembers its howl again. Peace on you.
offer.during: The old one sits by the pool. The others work at Redsand and the Ochre press.

objectives.label: Ask the keeper of the Well's Roll by the Saltwell pool for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the rabbit keeper at Redsand for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the vine keeper at the Ochre press for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
At dusk, ask the Keeper (at Saltwell Stores) to "Howl it with me", and howl with them at once.

quests.title: Oakhaven's Gathering Howl
quests.summary: Find Oakhaven's old gathering howl: three old wolves hold a piece each.

offer.ask: How does the old Oakhaven howl go?
offer.say: #greet#. Our howl's slow and it climbs, like good bark. Three old roots know it. Ask slow, and ask twice, mm?
offer.handIn: I have it, and we sang it under the town's roof.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Proper, it is. Slow and climbing.
offer.during: Two of the old roots fell timber at the cut. The third keeps the print house.

objectives.label: Ask the oldest feller at the Oakhaven cut for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the Oakhaven printer for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the old logger at the Oakhaven cut for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
At dusk, ask the Keeper (in Oakhaven, at the Acorn Inn or the Stores) to "Howl it with me", and howl with them at once.

quests.title: Frosthollow's Gathering Howl
quests.summary: Find Frosthollow's old gathering howl: three old wolves hold a piece each.

offer.ask: What is the gathering howl up here?
offer.say: #greet#. Our gathering howl goes low, so it carries down the shafts. Three of our old ones hold a piece each. Ask them twice.
offer.handIn: I have it, and we sang it low in the Frozen Lantern.
offer.during: The mine captain, and the two colliers at the Upper hearths. Ask twice; they hold it close.

objectives.label: Ask the mine captain at Kestrel Tarn for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the old collier at the Upper hearths for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
Ask the other collier at the Upper hearths for a part of the old howl, twice (they give half the first time).
At dusk, ask the Keeper (in the Frozen Lantern, Frosthollow's inn) to "Howl it with me", and howl with them at once.

quests.title: A Part of the Howl
quests.summary: Every town has lost its old gathering howl. Ask one of a town's oldest wolves for a part of it.

objectives.label: Ask one of a town's oldest wolves for a part of its old gathering howl.

rewards.detail: learned a part of an old gathering howl

quests.title: The Stones Remember
quests.summary: The old stone on the Sunfields remembers the last Moot, they say.

offer.say: #greet#. The old stone on the Sunfields remembers the last Moot. It'll tell you, if you bring it a windfall first.
offer.during: To me, not the stone. The stone's patient. I'm not. Chaff first, then honey, then a pot.
offer.duringAsk: Is it the stone I bring things to?

objectives.label: Bring her chaff: straw from the Larkholm threshing.
Bring her a windfall: honey from the Sunfields bee garth.
Bring her an apple: a clay pot from the Southmeadow potter.
Go up to the old stone on a clear night and read what it remembers.

rewards.detail: read the old stone on the Sunfields

rewards.text: The stone remembered. So do I, now. I'll tell you true from here on, mostly, my apple.

quests.title: The Well's Roll
quests.summary: The old keeper of the Guest Roll at the Saltwell pool wants a wolf to sit still.

offer.ask: What is the roll you keep?
offer.say: #greet#, my child. Sit. The well remembers who drew from it, and the howl remembers who sat still. Come back on Restday.
offer.handIn: I sat three Restdays, and I howled it for you.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Every caravan that ever drank is on my roll. You're on it now, at the bottom.

objectives.label: Sit with the keeper of the roll by the Saltwell pool on three Restdays.
Howl Saltwell's gathering howl for her, on the Saltwell square.

rewards.detail: sat three Restdays with the keeper of the Well's Roll

quests.title: Silver Under the Ice
quests.summary: The old King's toll silver lies under the Highmere ice. Haul it, in a party.

offer.say: #greet#. The old King's first winter, he sent the Kestrel mine's toll silver to the Sump kitchens by sledge, and the sledge went through the Highmere ice. I know where, eh? I want a charter for the Kestrel seam.
offer.handIn: The silver's down the Pass Road.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Now, the charter. Who's it to be, eh?
offer.during: Rope first, four lengths. Then the Highmere shore, and haul together. Go in a pair, eh? Ice is no place alone.

objectives.label: Bring the mine captain four lengths of rope.
Reach the Highmere shore, where the sledge went through.
Haul together on the shore, three times.
Bring the silver down the Pass Road to the Frosthollow square.
If the old camp below the Upper Mere stands, clear it so the silver can pass.

rewards.detail: hauled the Kestrel toll silver off the Highmere ice

bonus.detail: cleared the Pass Road for the Kestrel silver

quests.title: The Princess's Cough
quests.summary: The King's daughter coughs in the damp. The infirmarian at the Sump Infirmary wants help.

offer.ask: Is there someone you are worried about?
offer.say: #greet#. The King's daughter coughs in the damp and pretends not to. Bring me a yarrow poultice and herbs, then sit with her a while.
offer.accept: I'll bring them and sit with her.
offer.handIn: I've sat with her, and she has the poultice.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. She breathed easier. I noticed. I notice things.
offer.during: Any healer's shop, or make one: yarrow and a clean cloth. Bring herbs as well. She'll pretend she doesn't need them.
offer.duringAsk: Where do I get a yarrow poultice?

objectives.label: Bring the infirmarian a yarrow poultice.
Bring the infirmarian herbs.
Sit with the King's daughter on the Residence steps.
Let the infirmarian look at your paws.

rewards.detail: sat with the King's daughter through a damp day

bonus.text: The infirmarian looked at your paws, asked oddly exact questions, and wrote something down.

quests.title: The Scattered
quests.summary: Mirebridge was struck from the rolls. Its folk are scattered, and each has a scrap of its howl.

offer.ask: Mirebridge is still on your survey?
offer.say: #greet#. I've an old survey with Mirebridge still on it. Its folk are scattered from the Saltpan to the looms. Find them, and bring me a scrap of the howl from each?
offer.handIn: I found the scattered, and the first turn of their howl.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. A name and a scrap from each. The village is on my survey again, in ink.
offer.during: Eel trappers, mostly, who say they're the best on the river. Every one of them says it. That's how you know.

objectives.label: Find three of the Mirebridge-blooded and ask each for a scrap of the old howl.
Learn the first turn of the howl from the eel trapper at Withy Creek, at dusk.

rewards.detail: found the scattered of Mirebridge and a scrap of their howl

tests.name: Five wolves: howls found, side stories, Purse path and back, the relay runs, the charter given
A lone wolf: ready alone; full moon awaited; relay broken (scar); charter denied; bar short
Five active wolves: two tasks are not enough, the third moves the chapter on
Two hundred active wolves: 59 who did a task are not enough, the sixtieth moves it on
Advance anyway on day two: pushed; a waxing moon waits three days; the relay runs empty
The soft maximum: off, the chapter waits (ready to push); auto on, it moves on by itself
Waiting for the bar: enough wolves and days, but readiness waits until the bar is full
Side stories under way at the relay's call: their choices laid again, finished in the relay phase
